'''March 2001 Vancouver tournament (18 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hyperlight, Vancouver, BC on 18 March 2001. [[David Houle]] won it. It is known from David Houle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1938">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-23-vancouver-b-c-03-18-01d1938/ vancouver-b-c-03-18-01], DeckTech (David "TAZ" Houle, 23 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-23-vancouver-b-c-03-18-01d1938/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Hyperlight, Vancouver, BC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[David Houle]]
